decision: The index is ready for a bounded matched sampling trial, not a long run. Full inverse-frequency sampling reduces expected exposure to corpus-repeated questions from 13.44% to 6.22% in the audited candidate pool. At equal 131,072-row budget, within-stream repeated copies fall from 355 to 25; this adds only 330 distinct questions, so a large accuracy gain should not be assumed. Targets remain unchanged and no conflicting reference is chosen as truth. The next preregistered comparison uses the best 72k checkpoint, numeric-token weight 2 in every arm and 1,024 updates per arm after CPU parent/resume preflight. There is no new model or bot score from this audit.
compute: The CPU driver completed in 141.71 seconds (2.36 minutes), excluding allocation, Drive mount and dependency setup; index construction took 48.89 seconds. Sampling 131,072 rows took 21.42, 24.16 and 14.79 seconds for powers 0, 0.5 and 1 in that order. These are single, ordered CPU data-loading measurements affected by caching, not evidence of training speedup. All 60 exported count arrays passed their checksums. The runtime released automatically and Manage Sessions showed no active sessions. No GPU was allocated.
